# zero-progress

Progress indicator. Renders either a `linear` bar or a `circular` SVG ring driven by `value` / `max`. Four semantic colors (primary / success / warning / error) themed from theme tokens, an optional `%` label (`showLabel`), a `striped` animated fill for linear, and a `size` control (bar height / ring diameter). Emits `on-complete` when `value` reaches `max`. Built on `--uiv-*` tokens.
